description: This PHP class 'PerformanceReviewService' provides functionality for managing performance reviews within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for activating reviews, updating reviews, saving ratings, and generating rating keys, utilizing various traits and interacting with data access objects and entity classes.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewService
classes.description: A service class for handling performance review operations, including activation, updates, and rating management.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of PerformanceReviewDao.

methods.name: activateReview
methods.description: Activates a performance review for an employee with a specified reviewer.

methods.name: updateActivateReview
methods.description: Updates and activates a review after validating employee and supervisor status.

methods.name: activateReviewCommonExceptions
methods.description: Internal method to check prerequisites before activating a review.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateReviewRatings
methods.description: Creates reviewer ratings from provided data and saves or updates them.

methods.name: createRatingsFromRows
methods.description: Generates ReviewerRating objects from input data rows.

methods.name: generateReviewReviewerRatingKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key for reviewer rating entries.
